title: Is maahe moharram me
body:
Kya kya na hua mehshar is maahe moharram me
Zahra ka luta sab ghar is maahe moharram me
Shabbir hue be sar is maahe moharram me
Zainab hui be chaadar is maahe moharram me
<<DIVIDER>>
Seene pa sina khaakar , Maidaan me chakraakar
Be jaan hue akber is maahe moharram me
Hatho pa shahedee’n ke dam tod diya aaqar
Bano ka pisar Asghar is maahe moharram me
<<DIVIDER>>
Saqqae haram hae hae shaidaae haram hae hae
Be jaa’n dua darya par is maahe moharram me
Darbaar bhi waawaila baazar bhi waawaila
Thi bibiya’n be chaadar is maahe moharram me
<<DIVIDER>>
Is waste ae hilmi sar peet ta hu mai bhi
Sarwar hue hai be sar is maahe moharram me
